title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Six independent keyword searches, with eligibility checked from each full posting.
latest_update: October 7, 2026 — 6/6 searches completed, 16 query results reviewed, 11 unique postings validated, one qualifying new role auto-filed.

rows.title: Cloud Engineer
rows.gap: AWS networking, IAM and certification are central; Marc's AWS work is real but dated and not production-operated.

rows.title: Senior Professional Services DevOps Engineer
rows.gap: Customer training and professional-services delivery are heavier than Marc's formal consulting history.

rows.title: Lead Cloud Engineer
rows.gap: Requires production AKS cluster operations, networking and policy depth beyond Marc's current Kubernetes administration evidence.

rows.title: Senior Platform Engineer
rows.gap: Expert Kubernetes administration, operators, service meshes, Backstage and multi-region cluster lifecycle are the core deliverable.

rows.title: Engineering Manager, Cloud Engineering
rows.gap: Requires 2+ years formal people management of an on-call AWS/Kubernetes infrastructure team and a completed multi-quarter migration.

rows.title: Cloud Security Engineer
rows.gap: Requires 5+ years AWS cloud-security engineering plus deep Kubernetes security and AWS-native security tooling.

rows.title: Software Engineer
rows.gap: Full-stack product engineering in Go, React and TypeScript rather than SRE, platform or DevOps engineering.

rows.title: Engineering Manager, Notifications Platform
rows.gap: Software-engineering management for notification services; requires formal people management and distributed-systems product depth.

rows.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Azure)
rows.gap: Canada/Eastern time is outside the mandatory CET ±3-hour window.

rows.title: Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure)
rows.gap: Canada/Eastern time is outside the mandatory CET ±3-hour window.

rows.title: Security Engineer, Cloud
rows.gap: Posting explicitly limits remote work to the United States.

notes_sections.heading: Query audit
items: No CAPTCHA or verification challenge appeared.

method: Six rendered-browser searches were executed independently. WWR's generic Anywhere label was not trusted; each plausible posting was opened and read. One new role was auto-filed and two matches were already Applied.
